en.t: At nine o'clock in the evening, the teacher came back.

units.source_text: 四名警卫像往常一样出去巡逻了。

en.t: The four guards went out on patrol as usual.
There was nothing unusual at all.

units.source_text: 从外面回来的老师与禅海和尚两人交盏对饮，约莫至深夜零点三十分，

en.t: After returning from outside, the teacher and Priest Zenkai drank together, exchanging cups, until around twelve thirty late that night,

units.source_text: 这时寺庙的小僧才将禅海和尚领到寝室。

en.t: and only then did a young monk of the temple lead Priest Zenkai to his bedroom.

units.source_text: 老师说了一声洗澡，就入浴去了。

en.t: The teacher said something about taking a bath, then went off to bathe.

units.source_text: 7月2日凌晨一点钟，敲梆子声已经停息，

en.t: At one o'clock in the morning on July 2, the sound of the wooden clappers had already ceased,
and the temple had fallen completely silent.

units.source_text: 雨依然无声无息地下着。

en.t: The rain was still falling silently and without a trace.
